title: Small Business Development Center | University of South Dakota

facts.fact: The South Dakota Small Business Development Center offers consulting services including start-up counseling, business planning, market research, marketing, small business financing programs, financing analysis, cash flow and management, business expansion, and small business information.
facts.quote: They offer consulting services including start up counseling, business planning, market research, marketing, small business financing programs, financing analysis, cash flow and management

facts.fact: The South Dakota Small Business Development Center states that its consulting services are at no cost to small businesses.
facts.quote: Consulting services are professional, confidential, and at no cost to small businesses.

facts.fact: The South Dakota Small Business Development Center states that its offices can be located in Sioux Falls, Rapid City, Aberdeen, Watertown, Pierre, and Yankton, SD.
facts.quote: Their offices can be located in Sioux Falls, Rapid City, Aberdeen, Watertown, Pierre, and Yankton, SD.

facts.fact: The page lists the South Dakota Small Business Development Center's office hours as Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Coyote Business Consulting Group, a USD Beacom School of Business initiative, offers its consulting service to businesses at no charge.
facts.quote: The consulting service will be offered at no charge to businesses

facts.fact: Students participating in Coyote Business Consulting Group can receive academic credit and financial support.
facts.quote: students will have the opportunity to receive academic credit, financial support and real-world experience.

facts.fact: Coyote Business Consulting Group places a special emphasis on small businesses, although its service is available to all businesses.
facts.quote: Available to all businesses, but a special emphasis is placed on small businesses
